currentParagraphText: “A Truesoul cannot truly exist in two places at once within reality. Not unless they are clones or avatars. So with the Truesoul of the Unique Lifeform residing within your mask, it cannot also be within that fragment.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake got quiet as he slowly sighed internally. Honestly, he wasn’t even sure what he’d hoped to hear. He already knew the Truesoul of the Fallen King still resided within the mask, but that didn’t really help much. Right now, the Truesoul in Jake’s mask felt a lot like the Truesoul of Ell’Hakan that Jacob carried around – something he would definitely need to properly claim later.
